streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

description: Actual Viser captures of full yesterday replay, adjustable controls/Ink studio, and brush closeup. No v1 footage reused.
encoder_version: ffmpeg version 7.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

frames_continuous.timing_method: Subtract first timestamp; retain every subsequent recorded interval; final frame hold. Output resampled at 30 fps.

frames_controls.timing_method: Subtract first timestamp; retain every subsequent recorded interval; final frame hold. Output resampled at 30 fps.

frames_closeup.timing_method: Subtract first timestamp; retain every subsequent recorded interval; final frame hold. Output resampled at 30 fps.

customized_ink_scope: Ink studio is intentionally separate from native parity; no native-match assertion applies to the customized image.

recorded_values.scope: Display-only preview; source trajectory and verification remain unchanged
recorded_values.ink_semantics: Ink studio settings restyle all visible accumulated contacts, using pixel-scaled round footprints plus the exported triangles. Ink level is uniform, not consumed over time; Dip ink sets it to 100%.

limits: Illustrative brush and virtual radius-to-compression calibration.
Kinematic replay; no dynamics, material, fluid, collision proof or hardware accuracy validation.
